# Individual clothing layers — final generation prompts

Created with the built-in image_gen tool. Files are in this directory; the original generated files remain in the Codex generated_images library. Transparent PNGs are composited at runtime by layers.js; they are realistic 3D illustrations, not cloth simulation.

parts-base-v1.png is the same adult character, referenced from everyday-v1.png. All garment layers reference parts-base-v1.png for pose. The cardigan v2 opening was corrected with the image tool; the rejected v1 is not shipped.

## partsBase

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: the provided SEOUL STUDIO woman. Create a compositing BASE for an individual garment dressing game, a full-body realistic 3D rendered illustration of the SAME fictional Korean woman age 24, same face and adult proportions, centered facing camera with arms relaxed slightly away from torso and legs straight, hands visible. Wear a modest fitted opaque ivory short-sleeve crewneck T-shirt tucked into plain fitted taupe mid-thigh shorts, bare lower legs, small plain neutral cream flats. Hair behind both shoulders so no hair covers chest/clothes. Keep same full body scale and registration as reference: head top near y25, shoulders y260, waist y590, knees y1000, feet y1485 in 1024x1536 portrait canvas. Soft even studio light realistic smooth skin and woven fabrics. Entire image outside character truly transparent, no backdrop, no glow, no floor, no cast shadow, no text, no jewelry or bags. Completely clothed ordinary clothing, used only underneath other opaque clothing layers. Preserve original face. Full figure including feet no cropping.

## top-knit

Use case: compositing. Asset type: transparent individual clothing layer for a realistic 3D illustration dress-up game. Reference is the clothed 24-year-old woman only as a registration guide. Primary request: A lavender long-sleeve crewneck knit sweater, fitted and tucked-in hem. Sleeves follow the relaxed arms in reference down to just above the wrists. Shirt only, front neckline empty and transparent. Fine ribbed cuff and knit texture. IMPORTANT: render ONLY the specified garment(s) shaped exactly as worn on the reference, erase the person completely. No head, hair, skin, body, legs, hands, other clothes, mannequin, hanger, background or shadow or glow. Where the person or other clothes were must be genuine transparent alpha. Preserve the reference frontal camera angle, adult proportions, pose, soft studio lighting. Realistic 3D CGI fashion illustration, detailed woven material, NOT pixel art. Garment(s) fully visible with generous transparent padding, no cropping. The game will overlay this layer onto the reference base. Do not render a full person. No text, logo, props.
